d: Madhubani ASI Firing Case: rat ka sannata hai.... ek ghar ke andar ASI sahab maujud hain.... lekin tabhi kuchh aisa hota hai ki ghar ke bahar logon ki bhir jama hone lagti hai.... darvaja bahar se band kar diya jata hai.... ab sahab bahar kaise niklen.... aur tabhi achanak kamre ke andar se nikalti hain goliyon ki aavajen.... log idhar-udhar bhagne lagte hain.... chikh-pukar mach jati hai.... aur dekhte hi dekhte ek prem prasang khuni vardat men badal jata hai....bihar ke madhubni men jo kuchh huaa, usne har kisi ko hairan kar diya hai.... kyonki yahan koee aam aadmi nahin, balki pulis ki…
